items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I loved that clarinet playing by Barney Bigard. Those were my two men.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right. Mmm-hmm. Sidney Bechet. For a saxophone, first the soprano sax, then I picked up... I loved that clarinet playing by Barney Bigard. Those were my two men.
